hypothesis_notes.sci28_format: Standard Sierra SCI AdLib instrument: 28 bytes per voice. Each operator (modulator/carrier) uses 13 bytes. Fields: KSL_lo, MULT, FEEDBACK, AR, SL, EGS, DR, RR, TL, AM, VIB, KSR, ALGORITHM for op0; same for op1; plus 2 waveform bytes. If validation issues are few, this format is likely correct.
hypothesis_notes.register_pairs: Hypothesis: payload is a sequence of (register, value) pairs for direct OPL2 writes. Valid if most register values are in the OPL2 range 0x01-0xF5.
hypothesis_notes.sci28_plus_sequence: If SCI28 is valid, bytes after offset 28 are note/event sequence data for the sound effect (notes, durations, etc.).
